Coerce a validation result to a flat data.frame

Source: R/validate.R
as.data.frame.ggchord_validation.Rd

Combines the errors and warnings tables into a single data.frame and adds a severity column, which is convenient for filtering, exporting or printing the full report programmatically.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ggchord_validation'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

A "ggchord_validation" object.

row.names

Ignored.

optional

Ignored.

...

Ignored.

Value

A data.frame with columns table, category, row, column, message and severity.
